mapper.insert: insert into u_s_pageview (sitecode, visitorid, sessionid, pagetype, goodscode, pagepath, lang, referrer, clientip, country, useragent, device, browser, isbot) values (#{siteCode}, #{visitorId}, #{sessionId}, #{pageType}, #{goodsCode}, #{pagePath}, #{lang}, #{referrer}, #{clientIp}, #{country}, #{userAgent}, #{device}, #{browser}, #{isBot})

insert into u_s_pv_daily (sitecode, statdate, pagetype, goodscode, pv, pvhuman) values (#{siteCode}, #{statDate}, #{pageType}, #{goodsCode}, 1, #{human}) on duplicate key update pv = pv + 1, pvhuman = pvhuman + #{human}
mapper.select: select pagetype, sum(pv) pv, sum(pvhuman) pvhuman from u_s_pv_daily where sitecode = #{siteCode} and statdate >= #{fromDate} and pagetype <> '_all' group by pagetype order by pvhuman desc
select device, count(*) pv, count(distinct visitorid) uv from u_s_pageview where sitecode = #{siteCode} and isbot = 0 and device is not null and createtime >= #{from} group by device order by pv desc

select country, count(*) pv, count(distinct visitorid) uv from u_s_pageview where sitecode = #{siteCode} and isbot = 0 and country is not null and createtime >= #{from} group by country order by pv desc limit #{limit}
select country from u_s_ip_country where ipver = #{ipVer} and ipstart <= inet6_aton(#{ip}) and ipend >= inet6_aton(#{ip}) order by ipstart desc limit 1

select browser, count(*) pv, count(distinct visitorid) uv from u_s_pageview where sitecode = #{siteCode} and isbot = 0 and browser is not null and createtime >= #{from} group by browser order by pv desc

select count(*) sessions, ifnull(sum(s.views), 0) views, ifnull(sum(s.views = 1), 0) bounces from (select sessionid, count(*) views from u_s_pageview where sitecode = #{siteCode} and isbot = 0 and sessionid is not null and createtime >= #{from} group by sessionid having max(createtime) < #{endedBefore}) s
